description:
SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.

We are looking for an experienced Strategic Account Manager to manage their own portfolio of accounts, lead some of our more complex client relationships, and work across our wider client base on the initiatives that shape how we grow. You will build long-term relationships with your clients, lead go-to-market (GTM) planning for new products, analyse client and market data, and make recommendations to the Regional Director, EMEA on new sales plans.

You will take real ownership of your client accounts, work closely with the Account Management team and act as the internal “voice of the client”, bringing client insight into Product, Sales and Marketing decisions. Externally you will be the face of SeatGeek, representing the business in every client interaction, with the credibility to hold senior conversations with rights holders.

This role will suit an experienced commercial professional who wants to shape strategy as well as deliver it, and to work with some of the most progressive and established sports brands in Europe. It is home based, with about 30% travel and time on customer sites expected across our UK client base.

What you'll do

  • Lead GTM planning for new products and features across the EMEA client base, working with Product, Sales, Marketing and Client Services
  • Make recommendations to the Regional Director, EMEA on new sales plans, supported by analysis of client and market data
  • Identify trends, risks and opportunities across the client base and turn them into strategic initiatives
  • Build business cases and present them to senior stakeholders, internally and at client executive level
  • Act as the main point of contact for all matters relating to your accounts, building strong, long-lasting client relationships
  • Lead some of our more complex client relationships, acting as the senior point of contact for those clients
  • Develop and maintain strategic account plans for your key clients
  • Lead renewal and contract negotiations for your accounts, including extensions and multi-year agreements, and agree renewal close plans with the Regional Director, EMEA
  • Develop new business with your existing clients, including upsell and cross-sell plans for new product offerings
  • Forecast and track metrics for your accounts and across the client base, and report on account health, including internal and external QBRs
  • Act as the voice of the client internally, working with Client Services, Product, Engineering and other SeatGeek Enterprise teams to turn client feedback into better products and outcomes
  • Work with Sales, Partnerships and Marketing to produce materials that highlight client successes and generate referrals
  • Monitor the ticketing and sports software market, including competitors, and share what you learn with the team and our clients
  • Share best practice with Account Managers and support their development

What you have

  • Experience in a B2B strategic account management, sales strategy or commercial role, ideally in software or sports environments
  • 5+ year experience, including managing a portfolio of accounts and leading complex client relationships
  • Experience building and delivering GTM plans or sales plans, such as a product launch
  • Strong commercial acumen, including building business cases and forecasting
  • Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce, Dynamics or equivalent), Google suite and Claude AI
  • Analytical, with proficiency in data visualisation
  • Experience presenting recommendations to senior and executive stakeholders
  • Able to influence colleagues across teams without direct authority
  • Excellent negotiation, listening and presentation skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent time management and organisation across several projects at once
  • An interest in sport
  • Degree-level education preferred but not essential
  • Full UK driving licence
  • Eligible to work full time in the UK

Perks

  • Discretionary annual bonus
  • Flexible work environment, allowing you to work as many days a week in the office as you’d like or 100% remotely
  • A WFH stipend to support your home office setup
  • Generous PTO
  • Benefits package that supports health and dental 
  • Family building stipend and support
  • Annual wellness stipend
  • Annual subscription to Headspace
  • Pension
  • Life Insurance
  • Annual subscription to Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon music

 

SeatGeek is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment regardless of race, color, religion, creed, age, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, military or veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. As an equal opportunities employer, we recognize that diversity is a positive attribute and we welcome the differences and benefits that a diverse culture brings. Come join us!
